namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a4ed9727c.summary: Build a canonical graph from explicitly typed tables, constrained joins, and edge aggregation rules.

parameters.request: Request containing one to eight file/inline tables and a version-one projection specification; device and row limit are optional.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a4ed9727c.returns: A validated graph, complete=true, and provenance describing sources, joins, filtering, and projection.
details: Inline cells must be strings and rows must exactly match declared columns. Supports at most 256 columns per table and eight many-to-one joins; duplicate nonempty right keys are rejected.
Inner, left, and required joins use exact text keys; empty keys do not match. Optional time filtering uses an inclusive start and exclusive end.

Checks weight meaning against the task. Duplicate policy is preserve, reject, sum, min, max, or count; grouping includes timestamp and exact aggregation rejects unrepresentable results or conflicting attributes.
Final records preserve typed IDs, loop/parallel semantics, and source fingerprints. Vertex attribute conflicts and invalid final graph records are rejected.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1aeca17223.summary: Resolve a dotted path through nested JSON objects without copying the value.
namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1aeca17223.returns: A borrowed pointer to the field, or null if any component is absent or a parent is not an object.
details: The pointer remains valid only while the record and containing objects remain alive and unmodified. This lookup does not validate path syntax.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a6aa429fe.summary: Compare JSON values recursively while preserving numeric and structural type distinctions.

parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

details: Signed and unsigned integers compare by exact value, but an integer and a double are different types. Array order matters; object member order does not. Each recursive comparison charges work.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a403d3412.summary: Serialize a canonical vertex for predicates and record queries.

parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a403d3412.returns: An owned object with typed ID, optional label/type, and explicitly present attributes.
details: An explicitly present empty attributes object remains distinguishable from an absent one.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1aee907dcc.summary: Serialize a canonical edge without losing its original scalar representations.

parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1aee907dcc.returns: An owned object with typed IDs/endpoints and present type, weight, timestamp, and attributes.
details: Prefers the original integer or double weight representation over the normalized weight; preserves timestamp type and explicit empty attributes.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1AttributeP.summary: Validate and own the predicates used to match data records to query records.

parameters.query: Query graph used to validate optional query_vertex or query_edge bindings.
parameters.edge: Validate edge fields when true and vertex fields otherwise.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1AttributeP.returns: A predicate collection ready for repeated matching.
details: Supports eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge, in, exists, and eq_query. Checks field roots and dotted paths, operator/value shape, and query record identity.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1AttributeP.summary: Require every predicate applicable to this query record to match the data record.

parameters.pattern: Query record supplying an ID and optional comparison fields.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1AttributeP.returns: True only when all applicable predicates pass.
details: exists tests field presence, including a present null. Missing values fail other predicates, including ne.
eq_query reads the designated query field; ordered comparisons use exact numeric values or lexicographic strings. Predicates bound to another query record are skipped.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1PatternRec.summary: Build owned record objects and endpoint bundles for multigraph pattern matching.

parameters.graph: Validated canonical graph; external identifiers retain their integer or string type.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.
parameters.profile: COO profile preserving record identity and metadata.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1PatternRec.returns: Record vectors and a map from endpoint pairs to their edge-record indices.
details: For symmetric undirected storage, copies only the canonical half. Parallel records and self-loops remain available for matching.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a66d2ed14.summary: Enumerate injective query-to-data mappings with record predicates and parallel-edge multiplicity.

parameters.graph: Validated canonical graph; external identifiers retain their integer or string type.
parameters.query: Validated query graph with the same directedness.
parameters.induced: Require exactly matching edge bundles, including absent edges, when true.
parameters.emit: Callback receiving a borrowed mapping in query-vertex order; return false to stop.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.
parameters.profile: COO view profile preserving edge records.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a66d2ed14.returns: True when enumeration finishes; false when the callback stops it.
details: Tests self-loops and both orientations for directed graphs. With edge predicates, uses a bipartite matching within each endpoint bundle so distinct query edges require distinct compatible data edges.
Without predicates, labels and attributes do not restrict a mapping. Resource-budget exceptions can interrupt enumeration before completion.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a9a75c705.summary: Enumerate injective topology-only mappings between normalized mining graphs.

parameters.graph: Simple data adjacency.
parameters.directed: Check reverse ordered edges separately when true.
parameters.induced: Require nonedges to match as well as edges when true.
parameters.emit: Callback receiving a borrowed dense-index mapping; return false to stop.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a9a75c705.returns: True after exhaustive enumeration or false when the callback stops.
details: Checks pairs of distinct query vertices; this helper does not test labels, attributes, multiplicity, or self-loops.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a2b173818.summary: Convert a dense-index match into public typed query/data vertex pairs.

parameters.graph: Validated canonical graph; external identifiers retain their integer or string type.
parameters.query: Query graph owning the mapped query vertices.
parameters.mapping: Data vertex index for each query vertex, in query order.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a2b173818.returns: Rows with query_vertex and data_vertex fields preserving external ID types.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a78b22c33.summary: Validate graph-record query selections, filters, and operation-specific parameter combinations.

parameters.operation: Operation identifier; other problem families return immediately.
parameters.graph: Validated canonical graph; external identifiers retain their integer or string type.
parameters.args: Validated operation parameters; operation-specific defaults are resolved by the adapter.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1a78b22c33.returns: No value; invalid references or incompatible query parameters raise a runtime validation error.
details: Checks extraction modes, neighborhood-only parameters, aggregation scope/metric, explicit numeric fields, grouping fields, and direction restrictions before execution.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.summary: Check whether a JSON value is eligible as a scalar filter or grouping value.
namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.returns: True for null, boolean, number, or string; false for objects and arrays.
details: This type check alone does not test floating-point finiteness. Numeric key construction performs that validation.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.summary: Produce a typed equality/grouping key for a scalar JSON value.

parameters.value: Scalar value; numeric values must be finite.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.returns: A string key with a type prefix and canonical serialized content.
details: All numeric JSON kinds share an exact decimal-rational key derived from their display spelling. Other kinds remain distinct, so string IDs are not merged with numeric IDs.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.summary: Compare ordered scalar values using the query layer’s decimal numeric semantics.
namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.returns: −1, zero, or one for two numbers or two strings; two when their types are not order-comparable.
details: Numbers are compared as exact rationals of their decimal spelling; strings use lexicographic comparison.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.summary: Validate a record field name and optionally confirm an attribute path exists.

parameters.records: Records against which attribute-path existence is checked.
parameters.field: Top-level record field or attributes.* path.
parameters.edges: Use edge field vocabulary when true and vertex fields otherwise.
parameters.allow_absent: Allow an attribute path absent from all records when true.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.returns: No value when valid; otherwise raises invalid_input.
details: Known top-level optional fields are accepted even when missing. For an empty record collection, a syntactically valid attribute path is accepted.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.summary: Validate and own an AND-conjunction of record filters.

parameters.records: Records used to validate attribute paths.
parameters.edges: Use edge fields when true and vertex fields otherwise.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.returns: An owned filter set ready for repeated evaluation.
details: Supports equality, ordering, membership, contains, and exists. ID fields require typed external IDs and forbid contains; exists requires a boolean and can name an absent attribute.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.summary: Evaluate all validated record filters with explicit missing-field semantics.

parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.returns: True only if every rule matches.
details: Missing fields match only exists=false; even ne and not_in require a present field. A present null counts as existing.
contains searches a string substring or scalar array members. Numeric equality uses scalar_key; ordered comparisons require two numbers or two strings.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.summary: Build record-query indexes directly from canonical graph records.

parameters.input: Graph borrowed for the entire lifetime of this index.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.returns: Owned JSON record arrays, endpoint indices, incoming/outgoing lists, and an edge-ID lookup.
details: Preserves each canonical edge record once, including self-loops and parallel edges.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.summary: Build record-query indexes from the adapter’s declared COO graph view.

parameters.input: Graph borrowed for the entire lifetime of this index.
parameters.profile: COO profile retaining canonical edge IDs.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.returns: Owned record arrays and adjacency indexes using the view’s endpoint columns.
details: The profile determines which structural entries are present. The consumed view can be released after construction; the graph reference must remain alive.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.summary: Resolve an optional typed-ID selection into index positions.

parameters.args: Operation parameters.
parameters.is_edge: Resolve edge IDs when true and vertex IDs otherwise.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.returns: No optional value when omitted or null; otherwise a set of selected positions, including an explicit empty set.
details: Rejects unknown IDs and non-array selections; repeated IDs collapse to one position.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.summary: Construct validated filters for one parameter field and record kind.

parameters.args: Operation parameters.
parameters.edge: Use edge records when true and vertex records otherwise.

structgraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record__qu.returns: A Filters object; an omitted field becomes an empty conjunction.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.summary: Build filtered traversal adjacency while retaining the identity of each usable edge.

parameters.args: Parameters containing optional direction, edge_ids, and edge_filters.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

details: Direction selects out, in, or both for directed graphs; undirected graphs use both sides. Deduplicates the same edge within one vertex row, while preserving distinct parallel edges.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.summary: Run bounded breadth-first traversal over a prepared record-query adjacency.

parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.returns: Per-vertex hop distances with −1 for vertices unreachable within the bound.
details: The source always has distance zero. Edge identity is carried by adjacency but does not alter hop length.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.summary: Package bounded record-query rows separately from the complete matched count.

parameters.args: Validated operation parameters; operation-specific defaults are resolved by the adapter.
parameters.ports: Existing result ports, augmented by rows if absent and always by count.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1record_.returns: A result with matched_count, returned_count, output ports, and collection completeness.
details: Marks the collection complete exactly when rows.size() equals count. Truncated output includes a narrowing hint and cannot supply a complete collection to later steps.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Apply repeated unweighted neighborhood-mean propagation to a feature matrix.

parameters.neighbors: Adjacency rows matching feature row count; each row must be nonempty and contain valid feature indices.
parameters.features: Owned feature matrix, replaced layer by layer.
parameters.layers: Number of propagation layers; zero preserves the input.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: An owned matrix of the same shape after all propagation layers.
details: Accumulates each mean in long double and rejects nonfinite conversion. Propagation profiles add one self-loop per vertex so isolated vertices retain their own features.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Obtain the declared CSR view for node-feature propagation.

parameters.graph: Validated canonical graph; external identifiers retain their integer or string type.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A shared immutable view with one self-loop per vertex and collapsed parallel connections.
details: Weights are ignored. Incoming reverses edges, outgoing preserves direction, and undirected_projection symmetrizes them; invalid direction strings are rejected.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Run neighborhood-mean feature propagation over CSR neighbor rows.

parameters.view: CSR view matching the feature matrix and containing a nonempty row for every vertex.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

details: Uses adjacency only: stored edge weights are not used. The view must remain alive during the call.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Obtain graph-collection views with the declared feature-propagation direction.

parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A shared immutable collection view with collapsed parallel connections and one self-loop per vertex.
details: Weights are ignored; invalid directions are rejected before view construction.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Obtain graph-collection topology for structural feature extraction.

parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A shared immutable view preserving direction while dropping loops, collapsing parallel edges, and ignoring weights.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Build constant, incoming-degree, and outgoing-degree feature columns.

parameters.view: Normalized CSR topology; the structural profile removes loops and duplicate connections.
parameters.original_edges: Original edge count charged to the work budget.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A matrix with one row per vertex and columns [1, indegree, outdegree].
details: For undirected input, both degree columns count each incident logical edge; symmetric CSR entries are decoded only once.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Parse the numerical optimizer configuration for a learning operation.

parameters.args: Validated operation parameters; operation-specific defaults are resolved by the adapter.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: Training settings: epochs, learning rate, L2 penalty, and gradient tolerance.
details: Only gradient_descent is supported. Defaults are 200 epochs, rate 1, and L2 0.001; epochs must be positive, rate positive, and L2 nonnegative.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Evaluate the logistic sigmoid with a sign-dependent formula that avoids exponential overflow.
namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A double probability between zero and one, subject to floating-point rounding.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Evaluate log(1 + exp(x)) using a numerically stable formula.
Draw a small deterministic coefficient from the native random engine.

parameters.random: Mutable seeded random generator; one engine draw is consumed.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A double in [−0.01, 0.01), using the upper 53 random bits.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Serialize a host numeric vector for learning outputs.
namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A JSON array of double values.
details: The caller is responsible for supplying valid finite result values.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Serialize a column-major numeric matrix as JSON rows.
namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A row-major nested JSON array preserving matrix dimensions and values.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Minimize a supplied differentiable objective using full-batch gradient descent and Armijo backtracking.

parameters.configuration: Validated epoch, step-size, and gradient-tolerance settings.
parameters.objective: Callback returning loss and writing or accumulating a same-sized gradient; the gradient is zeroed before each evaluation.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A Fit containing final parameters/gradient, losses, accepted-step history, iteration count, and stopping reason.
details: Requires finite loss and gradient. Each epoch tries at most 60 halvings of the requested rate and accepts sufficient decrease with Armijo coefficient 0.0001.
Convergence means the final gradient norm is within tolerance. A failed line search or exhausted epoch budget returns a nonconverged fit; it does not certify a global optimum.
The objective callback is responsible for its own data-traversal work charges; this helper charges parameter-vector work.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Serialize numerical fitting evidence without asserting global optimality.
namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: A JSON report containing losses/history, gradient norm, convergence, stopping reason, completed epochs, settings, and global_optimum_claimed=false.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Validate rectangular numeric feature rows and copy them into the native dense matrix.

parameters.rows: At least one nonempty JSON array; every row must have the same width.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: An owned feature matrix with one input row per entity.
details: Every feature is converted through the finite binary64 admission check; malformed rows and unsupported numeric values are rejected.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Assign disjoint learning splits and attach labels only to their declared split.

parameters.data: Mutable dataset with unique entity IDs and id_field already set.
parameters.specification: Transductive split specification with required train IDs and optional validation/test IDs and labels.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: No value; populates the dataset’s split and target vectors, leaving unassigned entities as inference.
details: Rejects duplicate or unknown IDs, overlapping splits, repeated labels, null labels, and labels placed outside their declared split. Every training entity must be labeled.
Validation and test labels are optional; fitting later reads training labels only.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.summary: Fit a regularized linear readout to prepared graph features and produce predictions plus held-out metrics.

parameters.data: Owned dataset with aligned IDs, features, split labels, and targets.
parameters.task: classification for softmax regression or regression for a scalar linear response.
parameters.args: Validated operation parameters; operation-specific defaults are resolved by the adapter.
parameters.work: Mutable work budget and provenance context; traversal or allocation charges can raise a resource-limit failure.

namespacegraphmine_1_1runtime_1_1learnin.returns: Predictions, per-split metrics, reusable coefficient/preprocessing state, and a numerical training summary.
details: Requires a nonempty training split. Standardization, class vocabulary, and objective use training entities only; validation/test targets are read after fitting.
Optimizes mean cross-entropy or half squared error plus L2/2 times all squared coefficients, including the intercept. Initialization uses NativeRandom.
Classification returns class-ordered probabilities, accuracy, and macro F1; regression returns mean squared and absolute errors. Unlabeled evaluation splits have null metrics.
prediction_split controls which predictions are returned. Nonconverged fits retain their stopping evidence and do not claim a global optimum.
